continuity: Jin Taekyung, his family, Team Leader Choi, and the Skeleton King are currently staying at Cheon Taemin's heavily protected mansion, which remains publicly known as Taemin's residence.

Wu Shaiming, former Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China and leader of the Crown Prince Party, was imprisoned after corruption allegations and remained Xiao Yang's greatest political rival.
Wu Shaiming and more than fifty Wu family members, including children, died simultaneously from apparent sudden cardiac arrest while in custody, amounting to the annihilation of the Wu household.
Xiao Yang had been trying to obtain the Wu family's Mana Cultivation Method, which had enabled Wu Heixing to become an S-rank Hunter.

Jin Taekyung and Team Leader Choi consider Odin Guild the most likely perpetrator and suspect the massacre was intended to prevent the Mana Cultivation Method from being transferred or to answer the previous night's move.
Jin Taekyung intends to travel to Paris with Team Leader Choi to meet Odin Guild's master.
plot: After finally getting a full night's sleep at Cheon Taemin's mansion, Jin Taekyung learns that Wu Shaiming and more than fifty members of the Wu family, including children, were found dead after being imprisoned in Beijing. Xiao Yang had been trying to persuade Wu Shaiming to surrender the family Mana Cultivation Method that made Wu Heixing an S-rank Hunter, but the massacre destroyed that possibility. Jin and Team Leader Choi conclude that Odin Guild most likely ordered the extermination to prevent the method's spread—or as a response to the previous night's events—and Jin decides to visit Odin Guild in Paris to confront its master.

How did Odin Guild learn about the Wu family's Mana Cultivation Method and Xiao Yang's attempt to obtain it?
What consequences will follow from the Wu family's extermination and Jin's planned visit to Odin Guild?
